decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed extension with a doorway for public access and parking at the rear of the site with limited vehicular access and manoeuvring area would be harmful to neighbouring residents' living conditions through disturbance, poor outlook and noise.  This would be contrary to adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), C.3.2 (New or Extended Health Facilities), T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities For Developments), and T.5.3 (Vehicle Crossovers and Hard Standings), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 2 - The proposed hard standing due to its excessive coverage of the rear garden of the premises would be harmful to the appearance of the building and the surrounding area, contrary to adopted policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Development), and C.3.2 (New or Extended Health Facilities), of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposal would provide facilities which would not be fully accessible to persons with disabilities, contrary to adopted policies ENV-B.1.8 (Access and Facilities for People with Disabilities), C.3.2 (New or Extended Health Facilities), and 'Think Access' Guidelines of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, creation of a hard standing at the rear to provide three additional parking spaces, and disabled access to the front of the existing doctors surgery.
